text: At 79 minutes, Westport Albion adjusts their approach by dropping deeper across the pitch, reducing pressing intensity and slowing the tempo of play. The team maintains a compact formation closer to their own goal at the far end, aiming to protect their 3-2 lead. This change focuses on defensive solidity and controlling the game's pace [#1459].
